liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Desolation Row** (2 reviews): Named as one of the two high points of the show; Strong Garcia solo that slows right down, then picks up speed again [12][18]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Sweet jamming, with Vince finding a groove behind the song [18]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Listed as one of the few highlights of the night [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Desolation Row**: cut on the recording [23]
- **Deal, Set Break**: cut on the recording [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-29.135350.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.Flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 134 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording levels run higher late in the second set, and tape flips left some missing pieces [1]
- **gd1992-06-29.wklitz.me80.91644.flac**: source not stated; 16 songs; 140 min; rated 4.33/5 by 12 [5]. Said about its sound: This audience recording has clear, sometimes brittle highs, so it can pass for a soundboard; The crowd is heard clearly throughout, unlike the soundboard where Garcia's noise-gate pad makes it cut in and out [20]
- **gd92-06-29.sbd.gardner.9399.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 127 min; rated 2/5 by 13 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard's sound quality is good; Reviewer credits the recording's sound quality as the only reason for a decent score; Reviewer finds the mix crisp [11][15][18][19]
- **gd1992-06-29.135351.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.Flac1644**: audience recording; 17 songs; 134 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer left the show feeling the band's end was near, though about three years remained [12]
- Reviewer thinks Garcia may have been worn out; the first set was rough and second-set song choices disappointing [17]
- Called the weakest Deer Creek show ever, well below the strong first night there [13]
- Reviewer says the first night at a venue is the one to hear, not this one [15]
- Recommends the first night at Deer Creek instead, which was played much better [16]
- Has less instrument separation than the soundboard, but brighter high end [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-29.135350.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.Flac2496**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Set 1 Maxell MX-S 90, Set 2 Maxell MX-S 100;… [1]
- **gd1992-06-29.wklitz.me80.91644.flac**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 from Taper's Section [5]
- **gd92-06-29.sbd.gardner.9399.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR [10]
- **gd1992-06-29.135351.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.Flac1644**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Set 1 Maxell MX-S 90, Set 2 Maxell MX-S 100;… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-06-28 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-06-28-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [24]
